profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at SAS
profile.summary:
Dynamic and performance-driven system engineer with robust technical knowledge, documentation and communication skills. A forward-thinking professional focuses on solving complex problems, quick adaptive to emerging technologies, and deliver world-class experience.  

Leveraging resources from internal and external teams to solve the challenge at hand. Attained strong technical knowledge of Citrix and Microsoft technologies and consistently delivering effective solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Focus is on designing and improving scalable microservices that power advanced analytics and machine learning. I also develop AI integrations, embedding intelligent features into Viya to enhance automation and user experience. My role includes building APIs, optimizing data pipelines, and ensuring seamless connections with emerging AI technologies. I collaborate across teams to support cloud deployments, performance tuning, and observability so the platform remains reliable and innovative.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Evaluate customer business requirements and provide design recomendations leveraging the network, system, security, and database infrastructures. Development of custom solutions either by automation, development, restructure, disaster recovery, or migrations. Work with departments to develop strategies and improve current customer implementations.

Key Contributions

Easy Deploy NSX Advanced Load Balancer: (Front-End / Back-End Development | Automation )
Description: A virtual appliance that assists in the installation and integration of VMware NSX Advanced Load Balancer (formerly: Avi Vantage).

Languages & Frameworks:
• Angular
• Typescript
• Python
• Ansible
• Terraform
• CircleCI
• Gitlab Actions / Runner
• Node

positions.title: System Reliability Engineer III
positions.description:
Provided support on customer issues with NSX Advanced Load Balancer.
Assisted customers on the deployment/configuration across multiple platforms like VMware vCenter, Kubernetes, Openshift, AKO, AWS, GCP, and Docker. Implementation & troubleshooting of L4/L7 services. Developed custom solutions based on REST-API, Python, LUA, ansible, and terraform.

Key Contributions

Created training regime on REST API concepts along with python examples for the support team to be able to better assist on customer issues around those areas.

Developed and supported pre-upgrade tool to aid customers with preparing their environments and instances of NSX Advanced Load Balancer prior to undergoing the upgrade process

Knowledge transfer on ansible and terraform automation designs and concepts.

Provided training basics on LUA scripting to be utilized by the NSX Advanced Load Balancer support team to assist with custom functionality.

positions.title: Principal System Reliability Engineer (Acquired by VMware)
Senior System Reliability Engineer (Acquired by VMware)
Senior Automation Software Eng.
positions.description:
Developed enterprise custom solutions which included websites, web services, automation, workflow design, development, and product integration via scripting or development work. This involved integration with Citrix products but also with third-party products as well. Development ranges from custom dynamic websites to REST API development.

Key Contributions

Developed a custom automation solution for WestJet which reduces the need for pilots to carry their flight books. The solutions helped west jet save money cause of the reduced weight in flight and also made pilots' work-life comfortable cause of the reduced carry-on weight.

Developed a Customer Success Platform for employees to be able to handle customer requests, reporting, metric analysis, and communication. The platform was initially meant for small business customers but now it’s been for enterprise customers.

Configuration of the first Citrix Cloud service. This involved the preparations of virtual services, site2site VPN, NetScaler devices, and also the setup of the XenMobile service to manage corporate mobile devices.

Created training schedules for co-workers within the department to learn PowerShell scripting. The training camp was a success and now the training has been provided once a year for different departments. Attached to this also created a coding boot camp, a boot camp designed to teach the art of code development Based on C#, and provided teaching starting from beginner level to advance.

Creator of the automation design to connect Citrix ShareFile to Linux servers. This allowed eliminating the need for customers to set up FTP servers to work with the ShareFile product.

Developed a custom API to allow Citrix ShareFile to connect with ZenDesk. A custom integration needed a custom web form in which users submit a request and the system auto-generates a ZenDesk ticket and creates access to a Citrix ShareFile account.

positions.title: Lead Escalation Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the analysis, qualification, and ownership of high business impact & politically charged support cases with VP level visibility. Responsible for the review of Escalation team case backlog providing technical and case management advice to junior members of the team.

Key Contributions

Provide assistance to the escalation team with PowerShell scripts and techniques, code examples for troubleshooting, as well as labs to reproduce product issues. Working on ways to automate this test and troubleshooting technique to provide faster and better results. Also, assist with SQL database query troubleshooting as well as database issues. 

Design the E.L.E.S. portal. This is a formula but also a web portal designed for the sole purpose to analyze the workload of each one of our engineers providing feedback to upper management needed information to be able to design reports in regards, to case management quality, and increase headcount, and eng. performance. 

Developer of the Mouse Trap project, a tool with the purpose of providing customers a very easy method to acquire the most common data our engineers require to assist in troubleshooting their issues. The project is also participating in the Citrix Systems Innovation Challenge this year.

positions.title: Escalation Engineer
positions.description:
Supporting 99% of the Fortune 500 companies to resolve complex IT environment issues, my knowledge base has exceeded the boundaries of Citrix software to include the Microsoft OS and its inter-workings, as well as limitless 3rd-party software applications. 

Key Contributions

•	Assisted co-workers with action plans, scripts, self-made tools, and  case management for different type of troubleshooting scenarios and difficulties.

•	Developer of the Screwdriver tool the latest and only available tool to facilitate the troubleshooting of our Citrix Password Manager product

•	Provided advance level training of Citrix Password Manager to our Frontline Support team with custom practice labs. 

•	Restarted the Support Round Table meeting in the Fort Lauderdale area. This meeting are used to provide a link between Escalation and Frontline support teams which they can discuss freely regards support cases, product discussions, and troubleshooting.

positions.title: Lead Tech. Support Engineer
positions.description:
The Lead Technical Support Engineer is responsible for providing technical assistance on Citrix products to customers of large size, scope, and/or political complexity – via phone, email and/or remote access.

Key Contributions

•	Provided support as main contact for troubleshooting concepts, App-V, Windows, Networking, Virtualization, Active Directory, SQL, Script Development, Application Streaming, Printing, Infrastructure Design, and Installation scenarios.

•	Collaborated with forum discussions as well with more than 30 knowledge base articles, these include How To, Error-Fix, Technology Information, Troubleshooting articles. These help a lot of our users to be able to self-solve their problems and reduce the need to contact support directly.

•	Developer of the Application Streaming Launch Utility. Also received the Citrix Thomas Edison Award for this development.

•	Created the Weekend Schedule Portal this is a system in which creates an automatic report for the current schedule of weekend engineers. The manager’s only task is to populate the list in SharePoint and a weekly report is send to all managers with this information.

positions.title: Technology Specialist & Infrastructure / Security Engineer
positions.description:
Lead project designer of network infrastructures, security concepts, migrations, disaster recovery concepts.
 
Key Contributions.

•	The transition and implementation of IBM Lotus to Microsoft Exchange 2007 in stand-alone, and clustered environments. 

•	The programming of PowerShell and V.B. (Visual Basic) scripts for the purpose of automatic processes and easier administration of services for different type of clientele.

•	Provided training and presentations of different technical subjects in including, administration, networking, troubleshooting, Microsoft products, and security. 

•	Designer of network and security infrastructure on one of the top car dealers companies in Puerto Rico

positions.title: Chief Administrator
positions.description: Responsible for the supervision, administration, training, installation, and configurations of network and security infrastructures.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description: Application developer for the company’s specific clients, sales representative, customer service, calls center campaigns and technical support. Designer for web services and web pages with ASP.NET technology, and Macromedia Flash.

projects.title: Easy NSX Advanced Loadbalancer
projects.description: Easy Deploy for NSX Advanced Load Balancer (formerly Avi Networks) Fling is a virtual appliance that helps you deploy Avi in a handful of clicks! This will enable you to leverage the power of a multi-cloud application services platform that includes load balancing, web application firewall, container ingress, and application analytics across any cloud.

projects.title: Single Sign On Screwdriver - Diagnostic Tool
projects.description: The SSO Screwdriver is a diagnostic tool to facilitate the troubleshooting of the Citrix Single Sign On agent also known as Citrix Password Manager. The tool provides the user easier methods to monitor and capture the information needed to troubleshoot issues with the agent.
